description:
Compute an indicator series over recent candles. No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval). query_candles and calculate_indicator may require x402 USDC payment when enabled — invalid args are rejected before payment, and a tool error is never settled, so it costs nothing. Use indicator_id from list_indicators (not indicator). Paid when x402 is enabled.

PAID TOOL — 0.005 USDC per call, over x402 (eip155:8453). Call it once without payment: the answer carries the exact payment requirements. Sign them and call again with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. You are charged only when the call succeeds.

limit.description: Number of candles to use (default 200, max 2000)

output_field.description: Output series of a multi-output indicator; omit for the default series. Valid per indicator_id: macd: macd | signal | histogram; bollinger: upper | middle | lower; stochastic: k | d; adx: adx | plus_di | minus_di; ichimoku: tenkan_sen | kijun_sen | senkou_a | senkou_b | chikou; candle: open | high | low | close | body_pct | upper_wick_pct | lower_wick_pct | range_pct | is_green; reference_candle: found | open | mid | high | low; beta_btc: beta | corr. Any other output_field is refused before payment.

name: calculate_indicator
title: Calculate Indicator
